name: Sino Prima Gas Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sino Prima Gas Technology Co., Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of a comprehensive range of gardening products and accessories. Their diverse product offerings include power tools like battery-operated devices, lawnmowers, grass trimmers, and chainsaws. For cutting and pruning tasks, they provide various implements such as pruners, hedge shears, loppers, pruning saws, and grass shears. The company also supplies a selection of manual garden tools, encompassing hand tools, digging tools, specialized tools, children's garden tools, and complete tool kits. Catering to watering needs, their inventory features garden hoses, hose storage solutions (hangers and reels), nozzle guns and connectors, sprinklers, sprayers, pumps, and watering cans. Furthermore, for plant cultivation, they offer planters, composters, garden beds, greenhouse equipment, propagation supplies, and plant support services. Sino Prima Gas Technology serves a broad customer base through channels such as retailers, distributors, importers, DIY stores, garden center chains, and supermarkets. Its products are sold under the WORTH brand, with key markets being China and the United States. Founded in Shanghai, China, in 2000, the company was initially known as Shanghai Worth Garden Products Co., Ltd. It officially adopted its current name, Sino Prima Gas Technology Co., Ltd., in January 2021, and continues to be headquartered in Shanghai.
